proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12803.3 *kṣaṭ explicitly contains Punjabi che, Nepali cha, Oriya cha and Hindi/Gujarati cha; the addendum gives Jaunsari chau. These affricate six forms select section 3, not the ṣaṣ or *ṣuvaṭ branches. Exact survey form chāu is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 700 alagna explicitly lists Hindi/Nepali alag and regional alag/ālag separate. The different responses include transparent distributive repetition alag-alag; both repeated parts continue this same lexeme, not an unrelated second component. Exact survey form āllāg is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
